name: Elemental Appeal — kicked, the Elemental token it made gets +7/+0
notes: Sweep cast-condition leftovers (2026-10-06). "Create a 7/1 red Elemental creature token … If this spell was kicked, that creature gets +7/+0 until end of turn." produced nothing because "that creature" is a token the spell made, which the branch splitter refused to resolve. It now reads it as "target Elemental token", picked on the board, behind the Kicked toggle. Kicked on an Air Elemental token (4/4): 11/4. Not kicked on an Earth Elemental token (4/5): unchanged.
